final: WITH account_counts AS (SELECT a.account_id, c.town_city AS town, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN Financial_Transactions AS ft ON ft.account_id = a.account_id WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c.town_city), '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.account_id, c.town_city) SELECT account_id, town, transaction_count, 1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER (PARTITION BY town) AS town_transaction_share, 1.0 * transaction_count / AVG(transaction_count) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM account_counts ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
